reading: Recent graduates are increasingly using artificial intelligence to misrepresent themselves when they apply for jobs.
One applicant explained that the process was exhausting and demoralising without some help from these tools.
He thinks it is hypocritical for companies to ban artificial intelligence when they use it themselves.
Meanwhile, a recent survey found that most employers have suspected applicants of misconduct during the selection process.
One recruiter does not blame graduates for using these tools, given how brutal the current market is.
However, she noted that this creates an unfair situation because some people use the programs heavily while others do not.
To better judge applicants, companies are now relying on online assessments and video interviews.
Employers stress that they still want to see true authenticity and diversity of thought in new recruits.

vocabulary.definition: more and more over a period of time
to give a false or misleading account of something or someone
making you feel extremely physically or mentally tired
